_comment: Auto-generated by scripts/refresh_cli_models.py — do not edit by hand, EXCEPT default_model keys, which are human-owned config the refresh carries through (and validates against the extracted model list). Refreshed daily by .github/workflows/refresh-cli-models.yml.

codex._version_frozen: Held at 0.162.0, the last version the Harness E2E validated. 0.164.0 passed the local interchange and native suites (its new records are already read) but not the Harness E2E; unfreeze once it passes against a throwaway database, then re-declare VALIDATED_HARNESS_VERSIONS. refresh_cli_models.py skips bumping codex.
codex._extra_models_note: Human-owned, carried through the daily refresh. The binary's embedded slug list omits codex-family ids even though the CLI accepts them; on the API-KEY path they are the ONLY models codex-rs exposes MCP servers to (2026-07-17 matrix), so API-key users with tools wired need one offered. ChatGPT-auth accounts REJECT them (400) and instead get tools on their account's general models via the stock originator - which is why they are extras, not the default.

claude_code._version_frozen: Claude Code 2.1.310 defers every MCP tool behind ToolSearch by default (2.1.295 kept tool search off for a base URL that is not Anthropic's), so a turn's first request carries ToolSearch instead of NoClick's tools and the first-request tool gates fail. Frozen at 2.1.295 until the harness env sets ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false (which restores the tools on 2.1.310) and the Harness E2E passes on the new version; refresh_cli_models.py skips bumping claude_code.

opencode._version_frozen: Held at 1.18.35, the last version the Harness E2E validated. 1.19.4 passed the local interchange and native suites (same schema and records) but not the Harness E2E; unfreeze once it passes against a throwaway database, then re-declare VALIDATED_HARNESS_VERSIONS. refresh_cli_models.py skips bumping opencode.

openclaw._version_frozen: openclaw 2026.9.2 publishes its workspace bootstrap files (AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, ...) with a hard link and fails when link(2) is refused; the per-conversation workspace is a Modal volume, which refuses it, so every new conversation's first turn errors. Frozen at 2026.9.1 until that path works on our volumes (or bootstrap is skipped by config); refresh_cli_models.py skips bumping openclaw.
